replicate_statements: Spatial plots from cell deconvolution analysis showing the distribution of various immune cell populations in LUSCs (top) and mucinous LUADs (bottom).

The n=344/1148 'biological replicates' given later in the legend is explicitly attributed to panel B's quantification, not restated for the representative spatial images themselves.
